constraints.name: case_knowledge_status_consistency
constraints.def: CHECK ((((case_status = 'ongoing'::text) AND (result_status IS NULL)) OR ((case_status = 'closed'::text) AND (result_status IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: case_knowledge_publish_consistency
constraints.def: CHECK (((is_published = false) OR ((case_status = 'closed'::text) AND (needs_manual_review = false) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (published_by IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (lead_id) REFERENCES leads(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crm_activities_pkey ON public.crm_activities USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX leads_pkey ON public.leads USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_pkey ON public.notifications USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_phone_key ON public.users USING btree (phone)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX result_tokens_pkey ON public.result_tokens USING btree (token)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX case_conversations_pkey ON public.case_conversations USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_case_conversations_lead_id_seq ON public.case_conversations USING btree (lead_id, seq)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reminders_pkey ON public.reminders USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX case_knowledge_pkey ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX case_knowledge_lead_id_unique ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (lead_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_case_knowledge_service_type ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (service_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_case_knowledge_category ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (category)
CREATE INDEX idx_case_knowledge_result_status ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (result_status)
CREATE INDEX idx_case_knowledge_case_status ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (case_status)
CREATE INDEX idx_case_knowledge_published ON public.case_knowledge USING btree (is_published) WHERE (is_published = true)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX announcements_pkey ON public.announcements USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX previous_rejections_pkey ON public.previous_rejections USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_users_pkey ON public.admin_users USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_users_auth_user_id_key ON public.admin_users USING btree (auth_user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_users_email_key ON public.admin_users USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_user_scopes_pkey ON public.admin_user_scopes USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX admin_user_scopes_admin_user_id_idx ON public.admin_user_scopes USING btree (admin_user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lead_assignments_pkey ON public.lead_assignments USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX lead_assignments_lead_id_idx ON public.lead_assignments USING btree (lead_id)
CREATE INDEX lead_assignments_admin_user_id_idx ON public.lead_assignments USING btree (admin_user_id)

triggers.name: admin_users_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER admin_users_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.admin_users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_admin_users_updated_at()

triggers.name: trg_case_knowledge_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_case_knowledge_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.case_knowledge FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION case_knowledge_set_updated_at()
